What I do

Interiors, said plainly, so nobody rings up guessing.

  • Walls and ceilings, two coats, properly prepared
  • Woodwork: skirting, architrave, doors, stairs
  • Filling, sanding and making good before a brush goes near it
  • Wallpapering, and taking old paper off
  • Hallways, stairs and landings, including the awkward heights
  • Kitchens and bathrooms, in paint that will survive them
  • One room, or the whole house a room at a time
  • Dust sheets down, everything back where it was
